9dffcf3c: If input is a space, the DV parameter allows defaults ('d'), and the user has a DEFAULT value defined, set X to that value. If DV doesn't allow DISPLAY ('D') or STORING ('S'), write that value out.

168bda44: If the DV parameter doesn't permit SETting a value ('S'), execute the VALIDATOR code from the DD. If it permits VALUE-ONLY editing ('V'), execute the code from ^DIE3. If it allows setting a value, set CodeMode and execute the SET CONDITION code from the DD if it exists. If there's no DB(DQ) node defined, write out the external value.
